scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,blue "npm run dev -w @amazon-trade/api" "npm run dev -w @amazon-trade/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @amazon-trade/api && npm run build -w @amazon-trade/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @amazon-trade/shared && npm run typecheck -w @amazon-trade/api && npm run typecheck -w @amazon-trade/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @amazon-trade/shared && npm run test -w @amazon-trade/api
